select distinct brand from mall_goods where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' and brand is not null and brand != '' order by brand

select c.cart_id as cartId, c.goods_id as goodsId, c.quantity as quantity, c.create_time as addTime, g.goods_name as goodsName, g.price as price, g.image_url as imageUrl, g.stock as stock, g.price * c.quantity as subtotal from mall_cart c inner join mall_goods g on g.goods_id = c.goods_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.create_time desc

#{cartId}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_favorite (user_id, goods_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from mall_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: select f.favorite_id as favoriteId, f.goods_id as goodsId, f.create_time as favTime, g.goods_name as goodsName, g.price as price, g.image_url as imageUrl, g.stock as stock from mall_favorite f inner join mall_goods g on g.goods_id = f.goods_id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_browse_log (user_id, goods_id, browse_time) values (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select l.log_id as logId, l.goods_id as goodsId, l.browse_time as browseTime, g.goods_name as goodsName, g.price as price, g.image_url as imageUrl, g.stock as stock, g.status as status from mall_browse_log l inner join mall_goods g on g.goods_id = l.goods_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and l.log_id in ( select max(log_id) from mall_browse_log where user_id = #{userId} group by goods_id ) order by l.browse_time desc

select o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.user_id as userId, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.status as status, o.remark as remark, o.create_time as createTime from mall_order o where o.order_id = #{orderId}
